identity.name: gemma-3-12b-it
identity.summary: Gemma 3 is a lightweight, state-of-the-art open model family from Google, built using the same research and technology as the Gemini models.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only high-level training data description ('text dataset drawn from a wide variety of sources') and no evaluation details, so design/development/evaluation process is insufficiently documented.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card states training data only as 'text dataset drawn from a wide variety of sources' without dataset details, so training/tuning dataset documentation is insufficient.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: No training data access is provided in the card; only a vague 'wide variety of sources' description is given.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Because training data is not accessible or specified, content of training data used for outputs is not traceable.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card describes modalities and family but does not define intended use or downstream tasks, leaving relevant risks undefined as use changes.

specifications.model_size: 22.7 GiB of safetensors weights (24,374,793,024 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The model was trained on a text dataset drawn from a wide variety of sources.
